All tests pass. The fix has been applied to `units/duration.py`:

- Replaced the simple single-unit parsing logic with a regex-based approach that handles compound durations like `"1h30m"`, `"2m5s"`, etc.
- Uses `re.fullmatch(r"(\d+[hms])+", text)` to validate the input
- Uses `re.findall` to extract all `(number, unit)` pairs and sums their contributions

arguments.summary: Fixed `parse_duration` in `units/duration.py` to support compound durations (e.g., "1h30m", "2m5s") instead of only single-unit strings. Replaced the simple `text[:-1]`/`text[-1]` parsing with a regex-based approach using `re.fullmatch` for validation and `re.findall` to extract all number-unit pair...
